name: Potassium Nitrate (KNO3)
description: The macro nitrate source for Estimative Index dosing. Disclosed stoichiometry: 0.3 g in 10 US gal (~37.85 L) raises NO3 by ~4.84 ppm and K by ~3.1 ppm.
notes: Primary nitrogen source for high-tech planted tanks. Pair with KH2PO4 + a trace mix for a complete EI regimen.
